name: Infantry_Browser
author: Infantry AI
description: A browser for agents, by grant only: declares one MCP server (capability browser) that runs Playwright MCP (your installed Chrome, else Edge, else a downloaded Chromium; env INFANTRY_BROWSER=auto|chrome|msedge|chromium) with an isolated, throw-away browser profile (never the owner's Chrome, nothing saved between sessions), headed. Walled by default: it reaches a session only through a grant with a purpose (for example a ticket's mcp.require browser). Shows in MCP Tools as source plugin. Daemon half only.

mcpServers.name: browser
